question: Does a standard exchangeable GEE, using the strongest common-environment q values as a fixed mean offset, also estimate positive within-species route-night working correlation?
population_and_prediction: Exactly the 2,835 weather-eligible strictly-prior-history pairs and fixed q matrices used by the residual-dependence diagnostic.

model.response: wet calling-positive status at each species x stop cell
model.q_rule: q is fixed from the cross-fitted 72-h rainfall + prior SiteID history + dry persistence + pair incidence-matching comparator; no refit or tuning.

outputs: exchangeable working-correlation alpha for all clusters
alpha for clusters classified dry-route-silent using only drier state

interpretation.role: Methodological corroboration of the fixed-q residual-dependence result using a conventional correlated-replicate model.
interpretation.boundary: GEE alpha is a working correlation, not identification of a biological mechanism and not an occupancy-trend reanalysis.

provenance: No mean model, offset, cluster definition, dry-state split or covariance structure may change after alpha readback.
